📝 Mayor's Blog Update (Published: July 31, 2026)

Hanno City signed a "Basic Agreement on Cooperation" (Friendly City partnership) with Saitama Lions baseball team in March 2015 — the first such agreement in Saitama Prefecture. Following this partnership, we are supporting the team's summer theme this year: painting all of Saitama Prefecture in Lions blue to create unity across the region. Staff throughout Hanno City Hall are wearing Lions Ao Fest uniforms while on duty.

Let's tackle this summer's heat with the same cool determination as a Lions pitcher shutting down the opposing team — united in this fresh, refreshing blue!

Wearing period: Through Wednesday, August 26, 2026

Photo: https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/material/images/group/79/080729lionsfriendlycity.JPG

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/shiseijoho/shichoshitsu/shichoblog/shisei2026/shisei202607/14137.html
